reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Current Run markdown preview
reason: The changed journey is the compact Current Run preview of public harness commentary and provider progress. Nineteen collected ActivityLedger component tests cover inline code, formatting, inert links, status, and disclosure. One existing harness stream journey with inline-code regression assertions is selected in five permanent desktop and mobile browser profiles, including the 320 px boundary. A production build checks compilation and bundling.
exclusions: No Core, Python, native, persistence, authentication, or origin-sensitive behavior changed, so their test layers and unrelated UI journeys are excluded. Browser cases use a mocked harness stream; a real-Core replay and physical-device check remain separate acceptance gates. Full suites are excluded.
